section: Additional Variable Information: heat dissipation failure
excerpt: heat dissipation causes a process failure, if the difference between air- and process temperature is below 8.6 K and the tool’s rotational speed is below 1380 rpm.
applicability: Synthetic AI4I label definition only; not a validated equipment limit.
guidance: Review temperature difference and rotational speed as benchmark inputs. This does not establish a cooling fault on physical equipment.

excerpt: if the product of tool wear and torque exceeds 11,000 minNm for the L product variant (12,000 M, 13,000 H), the process fails due to overstrain.
applicability: Synthetic label definition only; not a physical diagnosis.
guidance: Review tool-wear time, torque and product type together as benchmark inputs. Model contributions do not confirm physical overstrain.

excerpt: Adding coolant and maintaining coolant concentration is required at regular intervals.
applicability: Haas mills reference only. AI4I has no verified Haas model or coolant measurements. Educational reference, not an equipment-specific instruction.
guidance: A future validated installation needs the actual equipment's approved coolant-maintenance procedure. These readings do not establish coolant condition.

excerpt: Inspect the retention knob [5] (pull stud) for damage, wear, and proper torque.
applicability: Haas toolholder reference only. AI4I torque is not retention-knob tightening torque; tool-wear minutes do not measure toolholder wear. No equipment match is established.
guidance: This reference illustrates why the actual toolholder model and approved inspection procedure are needed. Do not infer pull-stud condition or tightening settings from AI4I inputs.
